#  42422 - Protection of the Atmosphere Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **42422 - module is no longer offered from SS 2018**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Protection of the Atmosphere**  |  
|  Schutz der Erdatmosphäre   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Dr. rer. nat. Will, Andreas 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 2 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students are encouraged to do forecasts of (develop scenarios for) potential future changes based on incomplete knowledge. They shall experience the potentials of scenario statistics for environmental planning. The application in this module is to the protection of the atmosphere on the short-term (air quality) and the long-term (climate).  |  
| Contents:  | The module consits of two courses: **Strategies for the Protection of the Atmosphere (winter semester):**
  1. Problem analysis
  2. The atmospheric greenhouse 
  3. Man-made emissions 
  4. Effect on the atmospheric composition 
  5. Effect on the atmospheric greenhouse 
  6. The biogeochemical carbon cycle 
  7. Short introduction to climate modelling 
  8. Series of presentations by students

**Air Quality Assessment and Management (summer semester):**
  1. Introduction
  2. Air quality assessment based on measured data
  3. Essentials of EU framework directive (1996)
  4. EU daughter directives 
  5. EU data base for pollution measurements 
  6. Deriving the spatial distribution of pollutants 
  7. Use of air-quality models 
  8. Determination of model quality (model evaluation) 
  9. Air quality regulations in the U.S., Japan and China 
  10. Series of presentations by students

In addition, the students have to work during the semester on a small research project and present their findings in a seminar towards the end of the semester.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | 
  * Basics in Physics, especially Fluid Dynamics and Thermodynamics
  * Alternative: Basics in Atmospheric Physics and Atmospheric Chemistry 
  * Basics in Mathematics (esp. differential equations, numerical methods)

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 3 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Literature listings will be presented at the beginning of each course

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * 2 presentations (each 25%)
  * Assessment report with presentation (50%)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  |  **No offer from winter semester 2016/17!** The module can be studied in a flexible way, i.e. it can be started either in the summer or in the winter semester. However, it has to be completed in the following (winter or summer) semester.  |  
| Module Components:  |  **Winter semester:**
  * 420606 LE/EX Strategies of the Protection of the Earth Atmosphere

**Summer semester:**
  * 420603 LE Air Quality Assessment and Management

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 16.01.2017 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
